taskTitle: Where ten HTTP header fields are defined

checks.detail: 3 subtasks, read from the schema reply
5 phases had the tools designed for them

finalText:
I found a defining RFC and section for all ten fields. The one gap is that no worker could open the rfc-editor.org status pages, which returned 404. So "not obsoleted" rests on each RFC's own header, which shows no "Obsoleted by" line, and on a search for RFC 9111 that found nothing obsoleting it. The workers saw no disagreement between sources about which RFC is current. I did not open the pages myself and am relying on the workers' reports.

- **Age, Cache-Control, Expires:** RFC 9111 (HTTP Caching) sections 5.1, 5.2 and 5.3, at https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9111.html. It obsoletes RFC 7234. For Cache-Control, the quote comes from the section 5.2 introduction. The directives themselves are in 5.2.1 and 5.2.2.
- **Vary:** RFC 9110 (HTTP Semantics) section 12.5.5, at https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html. RFC 9111 section 4.1 only covers how caches use Vary.
- **Last-Modified, ETag, Location, Retry-After:** RFC 9110 sections 8.8.2, 8.8.3, 10.2.2 and 10.2.3, at https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html. RFC 9110 obsoletes RFCs 7230, 7231, 7232, 7233, 7235 and others.
- **Strict-Transport-Security:** RFC 6797 section 6.1, at https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6797.html.
- **Link:** RFC 8288 section 3, at https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc8288.html. Its header says it obsoletes RFC 5988. The worker could not open RFC 5988 to check that directly. The IANA registration in section 4.1 is not the definition.
